title: Super Mario Land
notes: Checked on MC-Gameboy_20260908 against the live picture 2026-09-07 with the (World) ROM, CRC 90776841 (the disassembly is Rev A; these three addresses held). Score: 200 on screen read 00 02 00 (packed BCD, high byte first). Lives: MARIOx02 read 2, x01 after a death read 1; not exercised above 9. Timer: 396 on screen read DA00 14, DA01 96, DA02 03; DA00 is the frame sub-counter, DA01 the BCD tens and ones, DA02 the hundreds; 400, 370 and the reset to 400 after a death matched. Not in this map because they live in HRAM, which the core's shadow copy does not cover (WRAM $C000-$DFFF only): world and level $FFB4, coins $FFFA, power state $FF99, game state $FFB3. $C0A8 holds the continue point (0x11 at 1-1), not the current level.
